name: Azad (Shaheed Azad)
contribution: Known as 'Shaheed Azad', he became associated with urban guerrilla resistance and paid with his life under occupation-era repression.
context: Occupied Dhaka’s resistance and detention context, 1971.
impact: His story remains part of public memory around wartime torture and sacrifice.
highlight: His martyrdom is remembered in narratives of urban resistance.
